temporal_behavior_check.method: Predictions from both the full model and a spectral-only (non-tautological) model were generated across the ENTIRE chronological trajectory (all 2156 files, train+val+test) and compared against the derived labels in 150-file chunks.
temporal_behavior_check.finding: Both models show a physically coherent temporal progression: healthy (files ~0-150) -> transition to degrading (~150-300) -> sustained degrading with a gradually increasing fraction of severe predictions from ~file 600 onward -> severe becomes dominant near the end (~file 1950+). This matches the expected bearing-spalling narrative (progressive worsening, not random oscillation). The spectral-only model's agreement with the derived label stays above ~90% through most of the trajectory and only drops near the very end (59% in the final 56-file chunk), which is expected since it cannot see the amplitude signal the label partly depends on.
temporal_behavior_check.verdict: Temporally sensible - not flagged as randomly oscillating.
